name: wpforms-lite

disable-css.note: WPForms 2.0.1.1 includes/admin/class-settings.php:414-438 declares the stylesheet enum 1/2/3, not post IDs. Native general settings save persisted string '2'.

global-assets.note: WPForms 2.0.1.1 includes/admin/class-settings.php:439-446 declares a toggle; src/Frontend/Frontend.php:1534 consumes it as a boolean, not an entity ID.

gdpr.note: WPForms 2.0.1.1 includes/admin/class-settings.php:453-471 declares the GDPR toggle; includes/functions/privacy.php:81-102 uses it in boolean privacy decisions.

gdpr-disable-uuid.note: Lite 2.0.1.1 src/Lite/Admin/Education/Admin/Settings/Gdpr.php:65-99 declares this as a disabled Pro-only upgrade control. General Save Settings persists its absent input as false; that default is not portable authored intent. Preserve target-local Pro/downgrade residue.

gdpr-disable-details.note: Lite 2.0.1.1 src/Lite/Admin/Education/Admin/Settings/Gdpr.php:65-99 declares this as a disabled Pro-only upgrade control. The privacy consumer does not establish a supported Lite authoring path. Preserve target-local Pro/downgrade residue.

modern-markup.note: WPForms 2.0.1.1 src/Frontend/Frontend.php:181-202 automatically initializes string '0'/'1'; src/Admin/Settings/ModernMarkup.php:55-145 conditionally registers a native toggle, saved as boolean by Settings. Retained native '1' establishes the non-reference type, not successful UI authoring of the hidden/legacy-dependent control.

validation-email.note: Native Settings::save_settings persists operator-authored validation copy here, not a visitor email. The semantic email-key guard needs this exact field review; no sibling or credential clearance is granted.

validation-email-suggestion.note: Operator-authored suggestion message containing the native {suggestion} placeholder, not a submitted address.

validation-email-restricted.note: Operator-authored rejection message, not an address allowlist or visitor data.

wpforms_settings.note: Only the named native general/validation controls are portable in this experimental slice. Unnamed email/payment/misc controls, credentials, integrations and installation/cloud state stay target-local; this is not an entire-options-blob grant.

wpforms_form_locations.note: Locator rebuilds this denormalized index from embedding posts/widgets and current native routing. The experimental global provider uses bounded SDK read/write contracts and requires an exact physical fixed point. This is not production, deployment or complete authored-state Apply readiness.

notes: Experimental authoring capsule for the exact observed official Lite 2.0.1.1 artifact. No certification, deployment, complete authored-state Apply, deletion, lifecycle or production-readiness claim.

Location repair has no triggers: native placements, widgets and routing can change while every form body stays identical. Policy selects this global provider for nonempty authored work; an empty Apply selects no actions. SDK native readers can warm request caches, so that external effect is explicit rather than claimed restorable by the database checkpoint.

Native add/update/duplicate writes prove optional integer/string self IDs and local field allocators; only declared post coordinates are references. Field IDs, numeric limits and smart-tag field operands remain local form structure.
The four exact notification scalar paths admit authored routing/display configuration, not submissions or arbitrary body PII. All keys, other values and secrets retain engine clearance checks.

QR page/logo IDs are native integers, including zero; Lite sanitization retains a custom-logo residue even when the paid logo UI is unavailable. Portability of stored references is not paid-feature support.

Runtime/payment/analytics/log tables are deliberately excluded. Shared Action Scheduler storage remains outside this capsule's ownership. Pro/addon fields, integrations, template conversion, submissions, mail transport and cross-plugin behavior still require evidence.
